001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 230, // -26
009    displayName = "ControlIQ Pump Control Mode (PCM) Change",
010    internalName = "LID_AA_PCM_CHANGE",
011    usedByTidepool = true // LID_AA_PCM_CHANGE
012)
013public class ControlIQPcmChangeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
014
015    private int currentPcmId;
016    private int previousPcmId;
017
018    private PCM currentPcm;
019    private PCM previousPcm;
020
021    private int pumpSuspendedRaw;
022    private int calculationAvailableRaw;
023    private int cgmAvailableRaw;
024    private int closedLoopPreferredRaw;
025    private int sufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw;
026
027    public ControlIQPcmChangeHistoryLog() {}
028    public ControlIQPcmChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentPcmId, int previousPcmId, int pumpSuspended, int calculationAvailable, int cgmAvailable, int closedLoopPreferred, int sufficientClosedLoopParams) {
029        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
030        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentPcmId, previousPcmId, pumpSuspended, calculationAvailable, cgmAvailable, closedLoopPreferred, sufficientClosedLoopParams);
031        this.currentPcmId = currentPcmId;
032        this.previousPcmId = previousPcmId;
033        this.currentPcm = PCM.fromId(currentPcmId);
034        this.previousPcm = PCM.fromId(previousPcmId);
035        this.pumpSuspendedRaw = pumpSuspended;
036        this.calculationAvailableRaw = calculationAvailable;
037        this.cgmAvailableRaw = cgmAvailable;
038        this.closedLoopPreferredRaw = closedLoopPreferred;
039        this.sufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw = sufficientClosedLoopParams;
040
041    }
042
043    public ControlIQPcmChangeHistoryLog(int currentPcmId, int previousPcmId, int pumpSuspended, int calculationAvailable, int cgmAvailable, int closedLoopPreferred, int sufficientClosedLoopParams) {
044        this(0, 0, currentPcmId, previousPcmId, pumpSuspended, calculationAvailable, cgmAvailable, closedLoopPreferred, sufficientClosedLoopParams);
045    }
046
047    public int typeId() {
048        return 230;
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * <table border="1">
053     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQPcmChangeHistoryLog:</caption>
054     * <tr><td><code>currentPcmId</code></td><td><code>raw[10]</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>previousPcmId</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>currentPcm</code></td><td><code>PCM.fromId(currentPcmId)</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>previousPcm</code></td><td><code>PCM.fromId(previousPcmId)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>pumpSuspendedRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>calculationAvailableRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>cgmAvailableRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[14]</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>closedLoopPreferredRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[15]</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>sufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw</code></td><td><code>raw[16]</code></td></tr>
063     * </table>
064     */
065    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
066        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
067        this.cargo = raw;
068        parseBase(raw);
069        this.currentPcmId = raw[10];
070        this.previousPcmId = raw[11];
071        this.currentPcm = PCM.fromId(currentPcmId);
072        this.previousPcm = PCM.fromId(previousPcmId);
073        this.pumpSuspendedRaw = raw[12];
074        this.calculationAvailableRaw = raw[13];
075        this.cgmAvailableRaw = raw[14];
076        this.closedLoopPreferredRaw = raw[15];
077        this.sufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw = raw[16];
078
079    }
080
081    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int currentPcm, int previousPcm, int pumpSuspended, int calculationAvailable, int cgmAvailable, int closedLoopPreferred, int sufficientClosedLoopParams) {
082        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
083            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(230, 0),
084            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
085            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
086            new byte[]{ (byte) currentPcm },
087            new byte[]{ (byte) previousPcm },
088            new byte[]{ (byte) pumpSuspended },
089            new byte[]{ (byte) calculationAvailable },
090            new byte[]{ (byte) cgmAvailable },
091            new byte[]{ (byte) closedLoopPreferred },
092            new byte[]{ (byte) sufficientClosedLoopParams }));
093    }
094    public int getCurrentPcmId() {
095        return currentPcmId;
096    }
097    public int getPreviousPcmId() {
098        return previousPcmId;
099    }
100
101    public PCM getCurrentPcm() {
102        return PCM.fromId(currentPcmId);
103    }
104
105    public PCM getPreviousPcm() {
106        return PCM.fromId(previousPcmId);
107    }
108
109    public int getPumpSuspendedRaw() {
110        return pumpSuspendedRaw;
111    }
112
113    public boolean isPumpSuspended() {
114        return pumpSuspendedRaw != 0;
115    }
116
117    public int getCalculationAvailableRaw() {
118        return calculationAvailableRaw;
119    }
120
121    public boolean isCalculationAvailable() {
122        return calculationAvailableRaw != 0;
123    }
124
125    public int getCgmAvailableRaw() {
126        return cgmAvailableRaw;
127    }
128
129    public boolean isCgmAvailable() {
130        return cgmAvailableRaw != 0;
131    }
132
133    public int getClosedLoopPreferredRaw() {
134        return closedLoopPreferredRaw;
135    }
136
137    public boolean isClosedLoopPreferred() {
138        return closedLoopPreferredRaw != 0;
139    }
140
141    public int getSufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw() {
142        return sufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw;
143    }
144
145    public boolean isSufficientClosedLoopParams() {
146        return sufficientClosedLoopParamsRaw != 0;
147    }
148
149    public enum PCM {
150        NO_CONTROL(0),
151        OPEN_LOOP(1),
152        CGM_INACTIVE(2),
153        CLOSED_LOOP(3),
154
155        ;
156
157        private final int id;
158        PCM(int id) {
159            this.id = id;
160        }
161
162        public static PCM fromId(int id) {
163            for (PCM s : values()) {
164                if (s.id == id) {
165                    return s;
166                }
167            }
168            return null;
169        }
170
171        public int getId() {
172            return id;
173        }
174    }
175
176}
